blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket won the jackpots in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 draws on Monday, Oct. 5, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 28-34-18-32-53-20 for a jackpot of ₱248.36 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 winning combination was 13-25-03-02-12-21 for a jackpot of ₱92.17 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
